title: 实验 4-8 · 加一个电压跟随器：两级 RC 滤波器不再互相拖累
summary: RC 低通 → LM358 电压跟随器 → RC 高通。跟随器把两级隔开：测中心频率处的增益，和上一个实验不加跟随器的结果对比。
concepts: 电压跟随器 voltage follower / buffer
输入阻抗高、输出阻抗低 high Z_in, low Z_out
级联网络函数相乘 H = H1·H2
description: 先看「拆开看」里的 **LM358 op-amp**（左侧会自动打开）：虚短、虚断和放大器公式都在那里。
**目标**：在上一个实验的两级之间加一个电压跟随器，消除负载效应，让带通的响应正好等于两级网络函数的乘积。
| 部分 | 元件 | 接法 |
| 电源 | 9 V 电池 | + → 8 脚 V+，− → 4 脚 V−（GND） |
| 第一级（低通） | R1（10 kΩ）、C1（15 nF） | 信号发生器红夹子 → R1 → 结点 A → C1 → GND；A 接 op-amp 的 IN+ |
| 跟随器 | LM358 的一个 op-amp | OUT 直接连到 IN−（100% 负反馈，增益 1） |
| 第二级（高通） | C2（15 nF）、R2（10 kΩ） | OUT → C2 → 结点 VOUT → R2 → GND |
| 脚 | 名字 | 属于 | 是什么 | 本实验接到 |
| 1 | OUT A | op-amp A | A 的输出 | 2 脚和 C2（第二级的输入） |
| 2 | IN− A | op-amp A | A 的反相输入 | 1 脚（跟随器的反馈） |
| 3 | IN+ A | op-amp A | A 的同相输入 | 结点 A（第一级的输出） |
| 4 | V− | A、B 共用 | 负电源脚 | GND |
| 5 / 6 / 7 | IN+ B / IN− B / OUT B | op-amp B | 第二个 op-amp | 不接 |
| 8 | V+ | A、B 共用 | 正电源脚 | +9 V |
LM358 里有两个独立的 op-amp：**A**（1、2、3 脚）和 **B**（5、6、7 脚），共用电源脚 4、8。表里用的是 A；改用 B 也算对——把 1、2、3 脚换成 7、6、5 脚即可。芯片横跨凹槽：上排从左到右 1、2、3、4，下排从左到右 8、7、6、5。
**仪器设置**
| 仪器 | 设置 |
| 信号发生器 | 正弦，幅度 1 V，**偏置 2 V**；频率依次 106 Hz、1061 Hz、10.6 kHz |
| 示波器 | CH1 接 VIN，CH2 接 VOUT；也可以把 CH2 挪到跟随器输出看第一级 |
**为什么要偏置 2 V**
单电源 LM358 的输出只能在 0 ~ 7.5 V 之间。低通会把直流原样传过去，所以跟随器的输入在 2 − 1 = 1 V 到 2 + 1 = 3 V 之间摆动，输出也一样，不会碰到 0 V。第二级是高通，电容 C2 把 2 V 直流挡掉，VOUT 又回到以 0 V 为中心。
**先预测**
- 跟随器的输入几乎不取电流、输出阻抗很低，两级可以分开算、直接相乘：**H = H_LP · H_HP**。
- 算三个频率下的 |H| 和相位、1061 Hz 时 VOUT 的 Vpp，并和上一个实验的 1/3 比较。
三个频率下读 VOUT 相对 VIN 的幅度比和相位；把 CH2 挪到跟随器输出看第一级。电路检查通过后，把读数填进下面的「测量」（以你自己的面包板为准）；答完后会显示计算对比。
**一般规律**：多级电路之间加缓冲器（跟随器），是工程上“让各级各算各的”的标准做法；代价是需要给 op-amp 供电，并处理好直流偏置。

**真实电路里**：LM358 的输入共模范围从 0 V（V−）到约 V+ − 1.5 V（这里 7.5 V），跟随器输入 1 ~ 3 V 在范围内；输出上限约 7.5 V（仿真也有这个限制），输出靠近 0 V 时带负载能力变弱，所以 2 V 偏置让它远离 0 V 是对的。真实 LM358 的压摆率约 0.3–0.5 V/µs、增益带宽积约 1 MHz，仿真没有这两项限制；这里信号只有几伏、最高 10.6 kHz，最快变化最多约 0.07 V/µs，都在范围内；但 1 V 幅度的信号到约 50 kHz 以上就会受压摆率限制，跟随器跟不上了。
startNote: **半成品**：电池、信号发生器、两级 RC（R1 + C1 低通在第 12 列，C2 + R2 高通从第 10 列开始）和探头都已接好，中间空着。**为什么**：这个实验的全部意义就是“在两级之间插一个缓冲器”。**你要做**：把 LM358 插在 e10（3 脚 IN+ 落在结点 A，1 脚 OUT 落在 C2 那一列），接 8 脚 → +9V、4 脚 → GND，再把 1 脚接回 2 脚。

en.title: Experiment 4-8 · Add a voltage follower: two RC stages that no longer drag each other down
en.summary: RC low-pass → LM358 voltage follower → RC high-pass. The follower isolates the stages: measure the gain at the centre frequency and compare it with the previous experiment without the follower.
concepts: cascaded network functions multiply H = H1·H2
description: Look at the **LM358 op-amp** teardown first (it opens on the left): the virtual short, no input current and the amplifier formulas are all there.

**Goal**: put a voltage follower between the two stages of the previous experiment, remove the loading effect, and get a band-pass whose response is exactly the product of the two stages' network functions.
**Circuit**
| Part | Components | Wiring |
| power | 9 V battery | + → pin 8 V+, − → pin 4 V− (GND) |
| stage 1 (low-pass) | R1 (10 kΩ), C1 (15 nF) | generator red clip → R1 → node A → C1 → GND; A goes to the op-amp's IN+ |
| follower | one op-amp of the LM358 | OUT straight to IN− (100% negative feedback, gain 1) |
| stage 2 (high-pass) | C2 (15 nF), R2 (10 kΩ) | OUT → C2 → node VOUT → R2 → GND |
**LM358 pins**
| Pin | Name | Belongs to | What it is | Connect to (this lab) |
| 1 | OUT A | op-amp A | A's output | pin 2 and C2 (stage 2's input) |
| 2 | IN− A | op-amp A | A's inverting input | pin 1 (the follower's feedback) |
| 3 | IN+ A | op-amp A | A's non-inverting input | node A (stage 1's output) |
| 4 | V− | shared by A and B | negative supply pin | GND |
| 5 / 6 / 7 | IN+ B / IN− B / OUT B | op-amp B | the second op-amp | nothing |
| 8 | V+ | shared by A and B | positive supply pin | +9 V |

An LM358 holds two independent op-amps: **A** (pins 1, 2, 3) and **B** (pins 5, 6, 7), sharing supply pins 4 and 8. The table uses A; using B is also correct — just use pins 7, 6, 5 instead of 1, 2, 3. The chip straddles the trench: top row 1, 2, 3, 4 from left to right, bottom row 8, 7, 6, 5.
**Instrument settings**
| Instrument | Setting |
| generator | sine, amplitude 1 V, **offset 2 V**; frequency 106 Hz, 1061 Hz and 10.6 kHz in turn |
| scope | CH1 on VIN, CH2 on VOUT; you can also move CH2 to the follower's output to see stage 1 |
**Why the 2 V offset**

A single-supply LM358's output can only move between 0 and 7.5 V. The low-pass passes DC unchanged, so the follower's input — and its output — swings between 2 − 1 = 1 V and 2 + 1 = 3 V and never hits 0 V. Stage 2 is a high-pass: C2 blocks the 2 V, and VOUT is centred on 0 V again.
**Predict first**
- The follower's input draws almost no current and its output impedance is tiny, so the stages can be computed separately and multiplied: **H = H_LP · H_HP**.
- Work out |H| and the phase at the three frequencies and VOUT's Vpp at 1061 Hz, and compare with the 1/3 of the previous experiment.
**Measure**

At each frequency read the amplitude ratio and phase of VOUT relative to VIN; move CH2 to the follower's output to see stage 1. Once the circuit check passes, type your readings into the Measurements below (whatever your own board shows); the worked comparison appears after you answer.
**The general rule**: a buffer (follower) between stages is the standard engineering way to let each stage be designed on its own; the price is powering the op-amp and taking care of the DC bias.

**In a real circuit**: the LM358's input common-mode range runs from 0 V (V−) up to about V+ − 1.5 V (7.5 V here), so the follower's 1–3 V input is fine; its output tops out at about 7.5 V (the simulator models this) and gets weak at driving a load near 0 V, so the 2 V bias keeping it away from 0 V is the right call. A real LM358's slew rate (about 0.3–0.5 V/µs) and gain-bandwidth product (about 1 MHz) are not simulated; with a few volts at up to 10.6 kHz the fastest change here is at most about 0.07 V/µs, within limits; but a 1 V-amplitude signal above roughly 50 kHz would be slew-limited and the follower could no longer keep up.
en.startNote: **Half-built**: the battery, the generator, both RC stages (R1 + C1 low-pass on column 12, C2 + R2 high-pass starting at column 10) and the probes are wired, with a gap in the middle. **Why**: the whole point of this lab is inserting a buffer between the stages. **Your job**: seat the LM358 at e10 (pin 3 IN+ lands on node A, pin 1 OUT on C2's column), wire pin 8 → +9V and pin 4 → GND, then connect pin 1 back to pin 2.
compare: - **1061 Hz**: the follower's output is 0.707∠−45°, VOUT = 0.707 × 0.707 = **0.5**∠0° (only 1/3 without the follower in the previous experiment). VOUT ≈ 1.0 Vpp.

Notice the denominator changed from "1 − x² + 3jx" to "(1 + jx)² = 1 − x² + 2jx": the missing jx is the loading effect. The follower's very high input impedance means node A doesn't feel stage 2 at all; its tiny output impedance (about 10 Ω) means stage 2 sees an ideal voltage source.

measurements.ask: 1061 Hz: CH2 on the follower output, amplitude ratio OUT/VIN
measurements.explain: The follower draws almost no current, so stage 1 is an unloaded RC low-pass: 0.707∠−45° at f0.

measurements.ask: 1061 Hz: CH2 back on VOUT, amplitude ratio VOUT/VIN
From your two readings, the gain of stage 2 (the high-pass) on its own = (VOUT/VIN) / (OUT/VIN)
measurements.explain: ≈ 0.707, exactly an unloaded RC high-pass at f0: the follower's output impedance is tiny, so stage 2 sees an ideal voltage source and the stages simply multiply.

measurements.ask: Multimeter DC range: the follower OUT to GND, the average
measurements.explain: The low-pass passes the 2 V offset unchanged, so the follower swings between 1 and 3 V, averaging 2 V; C2 then blocks it and VOUT averages 0.
H = jx/(1 + jx)², x = 0.1: |H| = 0.1/1.01 ≈ 0.099, phase ≈ +78.6° (0.097 and +73° without the follower).

hints: Power first: pin 8 to +9 V, pin 4 to GND; the follower is just a wire from OUT to IN−.
Stage 1 is R1 then C1 to GND, with its middle on IN+; stage 2 is C2 then R2 to GND, driven from OUT.
Keep the generator offset at 2 V so the follower never has to go below 0 V.
tests: 1061 Hz: VOUT is the product of the two network functions, phase 0°
1061 Hz: the follower output carries the DC offset, VOUT does not (C2 blocks it)

tests.name: 1061 Hz：VOUT 等于两级网络函数的乘积，相位 0°
1061 Hz：跟随器输出带着直流偏置，VOUT 没有（C2 隔直）

compare: 注意分母从“1 − x² + 3jx”变成了“(1 + jx)² = 1 − x² + 2jx”：少掉的那个 jx 就是负载效应。跟随器的输入阻抗极高，第一级的 A 点不受第二级影响；输出阻抗很低（约 10 Ω），第二级看到的是一个“理想电压源”。

measurements.ask: 1061 Hz：CH2 挪到跟随器输出，幅度比 OUT/VIN
measurements.explain: 跟随器几乎不取电流，第一级是不带负载的 RC 低通：在 f0 处 0.707∠−45°。

measurements.ask: 1061 Hz：CH2 回到 VOUT，幅度比 VOUT/VIN
用你的两个读数算第二级（高通）单独的增益 = (VOUT/VIN) / (OUT/VIN)
measurements.explain: ≈ 0.707，正是一个不带负载的 RC 高通在 f0 处的值：跟随器的输出阻抗很低，第二级看到的是理想电压源，两级各算各的、直接相乘。

measurements.ask: 万用表直流档：跟随器 OUT 对 GND 的平均电压
measurements.explain: 低通把 2 V 偏置原样传过去，跟随器输出在 1 ~ 3 V 之间摆动，平均 2 V；C2 再把它挡掉，VOUT 的平均是 0。

hints: 先供电：8 脚 +9 V，4 脚 GND；跟随器就是一根从 OUT 到 IN− 的线。
第一级：R1 再 C1 到 GND，中点接 IN+；第二级：从 OUT 出发，C2 再 R2 到 GND。
信号发生器偏置保持 2 V，跟随器就不用输出低于 0 V 的电压。
